prompt:
Editorial interior photograph of a real, lived-in home in Mexico, photographed for a paint brand's inspiration magazine. Full-frame camera, 24 mm lens, camera height 1.2 m, verticals corrected, deep depth of field. True-to-life color, realistic dynamic range with detail in the shadows, very subtle film grain. Real materials with honest imperfections. The painted wall is the protagonist: a flat matte painted surface, smooth, evenly painted, occupying 40 to 55 percent of the frame, seen frontally; its color must read clearly. Keep the upper third of the painted wall completely clear of frames, shelves or objects, keep generous wall above the furniture, and keep the lower-left corner of the frame calm. Nothing important within 12 percent of the left and right edges. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signage, logos, brand names, paint cans or book titles anywhere. No people, no pets. It must look like a real photograph of a real home, not a 3D render, not CGI, not an AI image: avoid plastic surfaces, perfect symmetry, overly glossy floors, generic American suburban interiors, and the cliché of a bouclé sofa with a round coffee table, olive tree and arch prints.

Register: middle-income Mexican household, aspirational but attainable. A real apartment or a house in a residential fraccionamiento, modest real proportions (room of about 3 by 3.5 meters), standard 2.4 m ceiling, white aluminum-frame window with sheer curtain, ceramic wood-look tile floor, flat white ceiling with a simple ceiling light. Furniture from a department store, well kept and tidy but not designer: mixed pieces that do not all match, practical fabrics, one or two family touches (a framed family photo seen from the side, a school backpack or slippers placed neatly, a phone charger on the nightstand). Clean and cared for, never poor, never messy. Natural daylight from mid-morning, bright and neutral-warm, soft shadows; no golden-hour drama.

Space: bedroom. The painted wall is behind the bed; leave the wall above the headboard completely bare.

The wall facing the camera is painted Berel "Bien y de Buenas" 1-3404D, exact paint color hex #B37A75, as seen under neutral daylight.

Variant: apartment in a mid-rise residential building; through the window, the facade of a neighboring building and a bit of sky. Double bed with a quilted bedspread in sand tone and two pillows plus two decorative cushions, one simple nightstand on each side, a compact wardrobe edge at the right.
